rows.grounds: adjective qualifying the portion as pertaining to Īśa
compound denoting a part or division associated with Rudra
absolutive expressing prior action of forming or constituting
instrumental plural agent; internal compound structure analyzed within the fused token as given

items.question: By what agents is the portion belonging to Īśa and Rudra constituted?
premises: A portion is identified as belonging to Īśa and Rudra.
This portion is constituted through a completed act of making.
The act of making is performed by Rāmakas characterized by form and unity with Rāma.
items.inference: The Īśa-Rudra portion is constituted by means of those Rāmakas.
uncertainties: The precise internal analysis of the compound in rūparāmaika rāmakaiḥ remains interpretively uncertain.
items.plain_english: Having made the portion belonging to Īśa and Rudra by means of the Rāmakas characterized by a single Rāma-form.
